notes.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos previews are here!
notes.content:
Release day is getting closer and closer, and previews are already here!

[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/warthog-fistfights-barrel-goblins-and-wooden-ghosts-this-action-rpg-is-10-times-weirder-than-elden-ring/][i]“Warthog fistfights, barrel goblins, and wooden ghosts: This action-RPG is 10 times weirder than Elden Ring”[/i][/url] - [b]PCGamer[/b]

[url=https://www.gamespew.com/2023/02/clash-artifacts-of-chaos-preview/][i]“Think of Clash: Artifacts of Chaos of a surreal take on God of War and you’ll have a good idea of what to expect.”[/i][/url] - [b]GameSpew[/b]

[url=https://worthplaying.com/article/2023/2/13/previews/135794-ps5ps4xsxxonepc-preview-clash-artifacts-of-chaos/][i]“At this moment, it has the potential to please fans who’ve been waiting so long to return to this universe”[/i][/url] - [b]WorthPlaying[/b]

Also, check out this article by our art director, Edmundo Bordeu:
[b][url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2023/02/09/clash-artifacts-of-chaos-art-style/]How Clash: Artifacts of Chaos Uses Traditional Techniques to Look Like an Animated Illustration[/url][/b]

And [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@the.aceteam]we are now on TikTok[/url][/b]! Follow us for all the cringy stuff that kids like these days.

Don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/Clash_Artifacts_of_Chaos/

notes.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date + new trailer!
notes.content:
Greetings Zenozoik inhabitants and other Corwids!

We come to you with a quick news: [b]Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date! [/b]

Thanks to the community feedback during our two public demos, we were able to pinpoints facets of the game that could be reworked and balanced. With this, we've decided to give ourselves a couple more weeks to polish Clash, in order to give you the best experience possible.

Clash: Artifacts of Chaos is coming to PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Series X|S, and PC on
[h1][b]March 9, 2023[/b].[/h1]

Pre-orders for are now open on PlayStation & Xbox!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/Clash_Artifacts_of_Chaos/

[previewyoutube=nY3-6HYVCRE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Clash: Artifacts of Chaos Demo is back until December 21st!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847511/574434bd3711392174e8f9f43c11cce6efc967c6.png[/img]

notes.title: 'Clash: Artifacts of Chaos' revealed
notes.content:
Dear community, it's been more than a decade since our debut title Zeno Clash released, and it's been over 8 years since we visited the strange world of Zenozoik again. We're extremely proud to announce one of our most ambitious projects yet. Welcome to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/]Clash: Artifacts of Chaos[/url][/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3955874/48fc4669cbe16dc3172cb1335fe7860eb9921f6f.gif[/img][/url]

For more information visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/]Steam page[/url] and don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Zeno Clash 10th Anniversary
notes.content:
Today marks a very special date that is dear to us here at ACE Team; 10 years ago on April 21st we released our debut title to the industry. Zeno Clash launched on Steam and with it we were honored to receive the support from our awesome community and the recognition of the industry that saw something unique in our first offering.

We wanted to celebrate this anniversary, so we've produced a commemorative [b]Zeno Clash 10th Anniversary theme[/b], developed by Patricio Meneses, accompanied by an awesome [b]illustration[/b] developed by our collaborator; Rodrigo Gonzalez Toledo. You can access the files here or through the following links. We hope you enjoy the materials!

[b]YouTube[/b]:
https://youtu.be/B2pKrUkGC-U

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1719630642&fileuploadsuccess=1

Music on [b]SoundCloud[/b]:
https://soundcloud.com/user-aceteam/zeno-clash-10th-anniversary

---

It's been a wonderful journey so far. Thanks to all our supporters and stay tuned for more ACE Team developments this 2019, as we are currently working on multiple exciting new projects!

notes.content:
Hi guys,

We're running a new Rock of Ages themed giveaway. This time we'll draw a cool [b]3D print[/b] of the game's lovely boulder lead! Ideal for your videogame collection.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/082a93850598e420c0bf86db376847bdd0650a95.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/434460/Rock_of_Ages_2_Bigger__Boulder/

[b]Twitter:[/b]

- Fixed Colosseum bug where enemies could path behind the perimeter walls.
- Fixed invisible allies that help in Colosseum mode.[/i]

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Recording the Main Theme
notes.content:
Here's a sneak peek of the recording of the main theme of Zeno Clash 2. Professional musicians performing in this video were accompanied by members of the choir of the Municipal Theater of Santiago - one of Chile's most prestigious cultural organizations. You can also get a glimpse of Patricio Meneses (director and composer) waving his arms like a madman. :)

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5OoDHJ5Z_T0

The full soundtrack of the game (which contains over 40 tracks!) comes as part of the 'Special Edition' of the Steam copy of Zeno Clash (which also includes an awesome digital Artbook). A preview of some of the Artbook pages is also present in the video.

Put on a nice pair of headphones and enjoy the music!

notes.title: The Malstrums Mansion and Chicken Barn
notes.content: Do you remember The Malstrums Mansion? This was a flash game ACE Team used as an April Fools joke before we released Zeno Clash back in 2009. The game was based on sprites that the three ACE brothers drew on a Mac Plus waaay back (We designed the game when we were kids *it is a shameless copy of Shadowgate*). So now that Game Hubs for Steam have gone live, we're testing them out with another one of our old designs from the 1980's. If you really have LOTS of spare time (there are a lot of better things to do), you can try out our first game design: Chicken Barn: www.aceteam.cl/chicken Malstrums Mansion: www.aceteam.cl/retro *Warning: The game is not as "sophisticated" as 'The Malstrums Mansion' Hope you enjoy it, and if you do, please give us your insight on this wonderful creation of ours in the discussions panel of the Game Hub... we might have more (and better) of this kind of games to share in the future ;)
